`time.Sleep()` is a blocking call that introduces delay but is NOT a source of nondeterminism for consensus purposes:
1. It doesn't return a value
2. It doesn't capture current time
3. All peers will execute the same sleep duration (from deterministic input)
4. The ledger writes (`PutState` at line 53) are not influenced by any time-derived value
